controls.authentication_scope: Source-only builder authenticates retained cell spans and exact raw records. Serving sidecar has an externally authenticated SHA and binds the layout root and fixed policy; do not claim each witness membership is independently proven from a root hash without a record proof or source read.

failure_labels.coverage_or_returned_quality: frozen arm FAIL; not universal rejection of representative routers

gate_order: source-only deterministic sidecar construction with requests/truth unopened
freeze all64 selections per dataset before truth attribution
selected-cell coverage mean>=0.98 and p05hits>=95 on BOTH datasets, otherwise stop representation arm
only if coverage survives, test all selected SQ8 rows with native full-block ranking; remeasure final quantization loss
fresh held-out and bounded routing scalability qualification before any production promotion

returned_diagnostic.meaning: all fetched blocks admitted; separate diagnostic of ranking after routing, explicitly differs from historical four-block nominee arm

routing.query_normalization: Reuse the unchanged native diagnostic query preparation, including original nonunit f32 query behavior; witness scoring must match existing SQ8 scorer bitwise.
routing.query_scoring: unchanged native SQ8 arithmetic on original SQ8 witness bytes; minimum score per cell
routing.selection: min(16,cell_rows); smallest source ID first; farthest from nearest selected decoded-normalized SQ8 witness; ties by source ID
routing.selection_numeric: Decode using existing SQ8 low/step coefficients into f32 coordinates; sum squared norm in f64, reject zero/nonfinite, divide in f64 and cast normalized coordinates to f32; deterministic squared-Euclidean nearest-witness distance with source-ID ties.
routing.training_inputs: authenticated retained cell SQ8 records only; no requests or truth

scaling_boundary.flat_scan: O(16*N/average_cell_rows*D) per query; NOT qualified for100M
scaling_boundary.next_if_representation_passes: qualify bounded resident search over witnesses and incremental generation lifecycle; do not scale flat scan by assumption
scaling_boundary.resident: existing directory plus packed probes and all live generations; arithmetic only until measured

scope: Native representation falsifier on unchanged retained partitioner layouts; no production winner or 100M qualification
split: consumed historical panels, not held out
